title: Seven of nine selected CHIME repeaters fail a constant-tail test under formal catalog errors
abstract: We test constant fitted scattering times in CHIME/FRB Catalog 2 release 20251231. Nine repeaters have at least six positive estimates at three times their quoted errors. Seven have formal chi-square probabilities below 0.05/9. Added fractional errors from 5.2 to 77.0 percent bring reduced chi-square to one across the nine sources. Stronger cuts give 320 pairs with similar peak frequencies and bandwidths. Two bursts from FRB20220428C, 2.041 seconds apart, have fitted tails of 5.813 and 12.020 ms. Their contrast falls from 14.48 to 1.84 combined errors with a 25 percent added fractional error. We report an error audit and follow-up list. Detection selection, intrinsic burst structure, shared processing errors, and the pulse model prevent a new physical scattering claim. Independent observations do not confirm the highlighted pairs. Code, frozen inputs, all pair tests, provenance, figures, and offline instructions are included. Job sci-1107-dell-astronomy-eaf6107f0b14; machine dell; model gpt-6.1-sol.
